Caring about someone isn't always enough to make a relationship work.

A little story about me

There was a point in my own relationship when my partner and I kept having the same argument. I felt like I was explaining myself. She felt like I wasn't listening. Instead of talking about what was wrong, I started keeping things to myself, thinking that avoiding the argument would make things better.

It didn't. The distance grew. Eventually I saw that the problem wasn't a lack of care. We simply didn't know how to say what we were feeling or deal with it in a healthy way.

That taught me something: many people don't struggle in relationships because they don't love each other. They struggle because they don't know what to do when things get hard.

Good relationship guidance shouldn't only reach people once everything is falling apart. Through strategic content, I help coaches share their knowledge, reach people who are quietly struggling, build trust with them, and connect them with the help they need.

How we work together

The same nine steps for every client, so nothing is left to guesswork.

  1. Discovery callWe go over your goals, audience, offers, challenges and current presence.
  2. Social media auditI review your profiles, content, positioning and engagement to find gaps and opportunities.
  3. Strategy developmentA tailored strategy based on your goals and ideal audience.
  4. Content planningContent pillars, topics, hooks, formats, CTAs and a content calendar.
  5. Content creationEducational, authority-building, storytelling, engagement and promotional content.
  6. Review and approvalYou review everything and I make adjustments before anything goes live.
  7. Publishing and managementI schedule and publish, and handle engagement and community interactions.
  8. Performance trackingI monitor reach, engagement, profile activity and other relevant metrics.
  9. Monthly reviewWe look at what works, what doesn't, and adjust the plan for the next cycle.

Questions you may be asking

I already have someone creating my content.

That's great. I can complement what you have by focusing on strategy, content planning, positioning and the overall social media system.

I don't have enough content ideas.

You don't need to come up with everything yourself. I research your audience, offer and expertise to develop relevant content ideas and pillars.

I'm too busy to create content.

That's where I help. I handle planning, creation, scheduling and management so you can focus on your clients and your business.

I don't have a large following.

You don't need thousands of followers to start. The focus is on attracting the right audience, building trust and turning attention into meaningful conversations.

Will you guarantee me more clients?

No one can honestly guarantee that. My job is to build a strategic system that improves your positioning, content, visibility and opportunities to generate inquiries.

I don't know what to post.

I turn your expertise, client questions, experiences and offers into clear content your audience can understand and relate to.

I'm not comfortable being on camera.

That's okay. We can use carousels, graphics, educational posts, voiceovers, storytelling and other formats that fit your comfort level.

How will I know if the strategy is working?

We track reach, engagement, profile activity, audience growth, content performance and qualified inquiries, then use the data to improve the strategy.
